scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team runs a non-blocking Lintwise trial in its monorepo to assess language coverage, finding quality, and cached and uncached CI impact, including queue waits; selected rules may become required only after review and agreement on acceptance criteria, exception authority, and a rollback procedure.

objectors.reason: The motion still mandates Lintwise immediately, while our discussion favors a non-blocking trial to measure its value, noise, and CI impact first.
The motion still mandates Lintwise immediately rather than reflecting our proposed non-blocking trial followed by gradually requiring validated rules.

chairQuestions.topic: Prior Lintwise findings and CI overhead
chairQuestions.experience_sought: What kinds of real bugs did Lintwise catch on your previous team, and how was the approximately four-minute CI increase measured?
On your side project, which languages and rules did you use with Lintwise, and what useful or false-positive findings did you observe?
